rows: The ambition-driven Zabuza finally realized what he really wanted after Haku's death.
To get Sasuke, Orochimaru summoned Nidaime to attack Konohagakure.
For more powerful strength, Sasuke ran away from Konohagakure with Orochimaru. To save the friendship with him, you risked yourself to trace Sasuke.
To seek Sasuke, you, with Naruto and Sakura, entered the lair of Orochimaru. But you never gave up trying for the friendship.
Sasuke didn't back with you in the end. You and Naruto went to Mount Myōboku with Naruto to learn Sage Art from Gama Sennin, where you met Jiraiya.
Akatsuki killed all residents of Konohagakure for their own did. The entire Konohagakure faced the hardest day, especially after the arrival of Pain
The Six Paths of Pain sweep through the Konohagakure Shinobi without a competitor. At the very moment, you returned from Mount Myōboku with Naruto to come across
The riot spread to Land of Water. You and your friends arrived at Land of Water to help the solution of Land of Water and win the friendship of Land of Water.
The riot spread to Land of Sand. You and your friends arrived at Land of Sand to help the solution of Land of Sand and win the friendship of Land of Sand.
The riot spread to Land of Earth. You and your friends arrived at Land of Earth to help the solution of Land of Earth and win the friendship of Land of Earth.
The riot spread to Land of Thunder. You arrived at Land of Thunder to help the solution of Land of Thunder and win the friendship of Land of Thunder.
The 7 Swordsmen, with 7 legendary katanas, disturbed the world of shinobi. You decided to terminate the Seven Ninja Swordsmen with Naruto.
The Akatsuki had long given up the dream set up at their foundation and turned into the tool to realize the the Eye of the Moon Plan by Obito Uchiha.
Forced into the hopeless situation by Akatsuki, Tailed Beasts get frenzied that they are scared of being caught and destroyed, just to revive the One in story.
Sasuke Uchiha founded the Taka to resist Akatsuki which his brother and Itachi Uchiha  belonged to. The purpose of Taka is nothing but revenge.
The final goal of Sasuke is to kill his brother Itachi which was his aim and lifelong fetter. However, Itachi took care of him since he was young.
Sasori of the Red Sand, who lost his parents at his childhood, killed the Third Kazekage and turned it into Puppet, and many other villainous things.
The Shinobi world was getting worse, you and Naruto kept studying Senjutsu, so that you can protect the people you care about.
The 5th KazeKage, with One Tail Shukaku inside him, is fighting for the peace of Shinobi World. Now he is trapped and expecting for your help.
Yakushi Kabuto is the smartest one in shinobi world. Powerful as he is, he hid himself in the Orochimaru. His Reincarnation can be better than Orochimaru's.
In order to revive Madara, Obito started to collect the ten Tailed Beasts. Now he is about to attack you and Naruto. Be careful and defeat him.
Through the effort of Obito, Madara was brought back to life via various divine spell. His astonishing force terrified all people that no one can even top him.
The Five Kages gathered at Konohagakure to discuss the way against Obito and Madara. To defend the peace, you and Naruto joined in the alliance.
By devouring constantly, Madara Uchiha achieved the Eye of the Moon and the second Sage of the Six Paths. The horrible power he owned flinches you.
In the end, you become Sage of the Six Paths. With the real power of Six Paths, you defeated Madara and maintained the peace of Shinobi world.
